title: research: screen rank-2 block helper inventory
body:
## Summary

Adds a source-pinned exact screen for one proposed local helper contract: replace eight rank-1 scalar products implementing one complete 2-by-2 matrix product with one recursive rank-2 helper. The candidate changes the selected per-call profile and returns the six units of freed rank mass per block to the rank-51 idle remainder.

The best optimistic profile in this rewrite class (`t=301`) has exact root bracket `[2632122649/1000000000000, 52642453/20000000000]` and complex kappa cap `52642453/20052642453` (about `0.002625212768012246`). The minimum count that moves the complex root past the selected bit root is 22 blocks per call. Even the maximum profile remains below `1/99`; with the bit supplier unchanged, the overall cap is about `0.001730427469823603`, below a 5% system gain over the selected `0.001672660197076918`.

## Scope and limits

This is an exploratory optimistic budget, not a source-mapped construction or supplier admission. It does not establish that the selected word contains any complete M(2) subword, and it omits extraction, frame, routing, addition, restoration, hosting, precision and consumer costs. No kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed. It is distinct from PR #3874's combined ideal-lever grid; related block/direct-sum and common-product work is credited in the package README.

## Verification

- `python3 -B research/complex-local-word-ceiling/verify.py`
- `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-rank2-block-helper-screen --check-only`
- `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-rank2-block-helper-screen`

The exact receipt is `research/complex-rank2-block-helper-screen/RESULT.json`. No full selected cold replay was run.

## Publication validation

`python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-rank2-block-helper-screen` passed on CPython 3.12.3, and `python3.12 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/complex-rank2-block-helper-screen --check-source-history` passed. The registered replay left the worktree clean. This supersedes any earlier pending note above for the registered package replay; separate full selected cold-replay limits remain as stated.
